final: WITH g AS (SELECT production_type_code AS code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS overall FROM g WHERE avg_price IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.code, g.avg_price, g.avg_price - o.overall AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE g.avg_price > o.overall ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
